module.description.shadowclient.spider: Get the ability to climb up walls.
module.description.shadowclient.stepup: Walk onto blocks without having to jump.
module.description.shadowclient.fly: Fly. Thats it. Its in the name.
module.description.shadowclient.autofish: Automatically pull back and recast the fishing rod.
module.description.shadowclient.autocrit: Automatically land critical hits every time.
module.description.shadowclient.antiknoc: Don't take any knockback from attacks.
module.description.shadowclient.camerano: In third person, allows you to move your camera into walls.
module.description.shadowclient.fastclim: Allows you to climb ladders & etc. faster.
module.description.shadowclient.airjump: Allows you to jump in the air.
module.description.shadowclient.parkour: Automatically jump at the very edge of blocks.
module.description.shadowclient.powdersn: Allows you to walk on powdered snow.
module.description.shadowclient.tracers: Draws a visible line to every loaded entity.
module.description.shadowclient.fastbrea: Allows you to break blocks faster.
module.description.shadowclient.secretsh: Super Secret Settings made accessible again.
module.description.shadowclient.derpy: Rotates your head around like wild (visible to others).
module.description.shadowclient.notilton: Doesn't tilt the camera if you get hurt.
module.description.shadowclient.rainbowg: Makes the UI instead of being black, go to rainbow.
module.description.shadowclient.nofireov: Lower or hide the effect when you get set on fire.
module.description.shadowclient.autocrys: Automatically detonate (not place) crystals in your area.
module.description.shadowclient.updatesd: Disables the ShadowClient update cycle completely.
module.description.shadowclient.nowaterp: Prevents flowing water from pushing you.
module.description.shadowclient.savedata: Saves the current configuration to the settings file.
module.description.shadowclient.loaddata: Loads the saved configuration from the settings file.
module.description.shadowclient.showsett: Shows the hack client settings menu.
module.description.shadowclient.hidesett: Hides the hack client settings menu.
module.description.shadowclient.killaura: Attacks every attackable entity in your range.
module.description.shadowclient.packetlo: See what packets are being sent between you and the server.
module.description.shadowclient.nightvis: Allows you to see in darkness.
module.description.shadowclient.noblind: Allows you to see through blindness and darkness.
module.description.shadowclient.nowobble: Stops the wobble from nausea and portals.
module.description.shadowclient.boatfly: Allows you to fly in boats and other vehicles.
module.description.shadowclient.noentity: Prevents you from getting pushed by entities.
module.description.shadowclient.autohotb: Cycles through your hotbar extremely fast.
module.description.shadowclient.nopumpki: No pumpkin overlay when wearing one.
module.description.shadowclient.portalgu: Allows you to open your inventory while in portals.
module.description.shadowclient.noslowdo: Stops items and blocks from slowing you.
module.description.shadowclient.advanced: Opens a more detailed Help inside your browser.
module.description.shadowclient.safewalk: Stops you from falling off ledges when walking.
module.description.shadowclient.dinnerbo: Flips every living entity upside down.
module.description.shadowclient.deathnot: Tells you the coordinates of your death.
module.description.shadowclient.blink: Interrupts all movements packets for a while, so it looks like you are lagging.
module.description.shadowclient.trajecto: Draws a line where projectiles will go.
module.description.shadowclient.xray: Only render ores or other blocks.
module.description.shadowclient.shadowhu: Renders a minimalistic hud showing useful info.
module.description.shadowclient.nooverla: Disabled the screen from turning blue in water.
module.description.shadowclient.chestste: Adds a button to the chest UI to steal all contents.
module.description.shadowclient.weatherc: Lets you change things about the weather and daytime.
module.description.shadowclient.flatitem: Items lay down flat on the floor.
module.description.shadowclient.clicktp: Teleports you to wherever you click (sprint key + use key).
module.description.shadowclient.lightove: Renders an overlay on blocks indicating if mobs can/will spawn.
module.description.shadowclient.unfocuse: Decreases the FPS when the game is unfocused.
module.description.shadowclient.zoom: Lets you zoom in (and out) beyond the vanilla limit.
module.description.shadowclient.autohit: Automatically hit entities if infront of your crosshair.
